title: NCL Mining Sirdar T&S Gr. C — Mock 03
pattern: NCL Mining Sirdar CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 90 min · no -ve)

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Vehicle Proximity Detection System' in opencast mines helps to
options: Reduce fuel consumption of the fleet
Alert operators of nearby vehicles and prevent collisions
Allow higher speeds on haul-road gradients
Automatically record tyre pressure and temperature
questions.solution: Proximity detection systems alert operators to nearby vehicles to prevent collisions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Dozer push effective up to
questions.solution: Effective dozer push is economical up to about 100 m.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Principal Rescue Station is in
options: At the corporate headquarters of the company
questions.solution: Each mining district.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Geological Mapping Report includes
options: Daily production and equipment utilisation figures
Rock types, structures, seam positions, quality data
List of mining equipment and their availability
questions.solution: Rocks, structures, seams, quality.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Bench stability in opencast mining is primarily affected by
options: Geological discontinuities, groundwater, and blast damage
questions.solution: Bench stability depends on geological features, groundwater, and blast-induced damage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Casting dozer' casts overburden into
questions.solution: Mined-out void.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Regulatory Compliance' under CMR 2017 is the responsibility of
options: The Directorate General of Mines Safety only
questions.solution: Regulatory compliance is the primary responsibility of mine owner and management.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'truck fleet optimization' balances
options: Tyre brand and retreading policy only
Mean time between failures of trucks only
Shovel-truck match, cycle times, and production targets
questions.solution: Fleet optimization balances equipment matching, cycle times, and targets.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A mine closure report should cover
options: The land survey records and the findings obtained from them
The projected coal price and its market trends
The contractor's bills and their payment details
Environmental status, reclamation progress, water quality, and post-closure monitoring plan
questions.solution: Closure reports must comprehensively cover environmental status, reclamation, and long-term monitoring plans.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'ramp' in opencast mining is designed for
questions.solution: Ramps provide safe vehicular access between different bench levels.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The mine plan report includes
options: Plans, sections, and elevations of all underground and surface workings
questions.solution: Mine plan reports include detailed plans, sections, and elevations showing all mine workings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Slurry explosives preferred when
questions.solution: Water present.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Strip mining' is synonymous with
questions.solution: Opencast mining.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Working alone in opencast is
questions.solution: Generally prohibited.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: DGMS stands for
questions.solution: Directorate General of Mines Safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Safety Performance Dashboard' in mines should display
options: Leading and lagging indicators with trends
questions.solution: Dashboards should show leading and lagging indicators with trends.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Regulation 108 of CMR 2017 deals with
questions.solution: Regulation 108 of CMR 2017 deals with spoil-banks and dumps; the Safety Management Plan is Reg. 104.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Self-rescuer provides at least
questions.solution: Standard self-rescuers (SCSR) used in Indian coal mines are rated for at least 30 minutes of breathable air.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stemming confines
options: Water seeping into the blast hole
Movement of workers near the face
questions.solution: Explosive energy.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'delay detonator' allows
options: Controlled timing between holes to optimize fragmentation
A single massive explosion of the round
questions.solution: Delay detonators provide controlled time intervals between hole detonations for better fragmentation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Production Report covers
options: Coal/overburden quantities, equipment utilization, stripping ratio
Only the daily attendance of operators
Only the fuel consumption of each machine
Only the list of breakdowns during the shift
questions.solution: Quantities, utilization, ratio.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Employment of Women' in mines under the Mines Act is regulated by
questions.solution: Section 46 of the Mines Act 1952 regulates employment of women in mines; Section 45 deals with persons below 18 years.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Fatal accidents reported within
questions.solution: Fatal accidents must be reported to the Inspector forthwith by telephone, with written notice (Form IV-A) within 24 hours (CMR 2017 Reg. 8; Mines Rules 1955 Rule 23).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'scope and limitations' section defines
options: Boundaries and constraints of the report
questions.solution: This section defines what the report covers and its constraints.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Gas Testing' in mines under Mines Rules 1955 is the responsibility of
options: Any worker available on the shift
A competent person trained in gas detection
questions.solution: Gas testing must be conducted by competent persons trained in gas detection.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'End dumping' deposits from
questions.solution: Edge of bench.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A Job Safety Analysis (JSA) breaks a job into
options: Individual steps and identifies hazards at each step
Only the personal protective equipment required
Only the time required to complete the job
Only the cost of the job
questions.solution: JSA systematically breaks down a job into steps and identifies hazards for each step.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stemming length affects
options: Only the quantity of explosive that can be loaded
Only the drilling rate of the blast holes
Only the type of detonator that can be used
Confinement of explosive energy and fragmentation
questions.solution: Confinement and fragmentation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Lifeline' in underground mines under Mines Rules is
options: A continuous line for guidance of rescue teams
questions.solution: Lifelines are continuous guidance lines for rescue teams in underground mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'safety culture survey' in mines measures
options: Only the number of safety training programmes conducted
Only the frequency of toolbox talks
Worker perceptions and attitudes toward safety
Only the number of near-miss reports submitted
questions.solution: Culture surveys measure worker perceptions and attitudes toward safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rules 1955, 'Withdrawal' of workers from a dangerous area is the responsibility of
options: The contractor engaged for the work
Any worker present in the area
The Mine Manager or authorized person
The village head of the locality
questions.solution: Withdrawal of workers from dangerous areas is the responsibility of the Mine Manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Emergency Response Drill' frequency at opencast mines should be
questions.solution: Emergency drills should be conducted at least twice yearly.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'reclamation quality audit' assesses
options: Only the volume of overburden rehandled
Only the survival rate of planted saplings
Only the cost of reclamation works
Compliance with specifications and environmental standards
questions.solution: Quality audits assess compliance with specifications and environmental standards.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rules 1955, 'Coal Dust' suppression methods include
options: Stone dusting, water spraying, and rock dust barriers
questions.solution: Coal dust suppression requires stone dusting, water spraying, and barriers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Cutoff' occurs when
options: A later hole detonates before an earlier hole in the sequence due to timing loss
All holes in the round fire exactly as designed
The blast is cancelled due to presence of gas
questions.solution: Cutoff occurs when a later hole detonates before an earlier hole in the sequence due to timing loss.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Sub-grade' excavation is done for
questions.solution: Drainage below seam floor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Section 2 of the Mines Act 1952 deals with
questions.solution: Section 2 of the Mines Act 1952 contains the definitions of key terms; Section 3 deals with 'Act not to apply in certain cases'.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Bench marking' in surveying establishes
questions.solution: Establishes reference elevations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'logical flow' in a report means
options: Ideas presented in a sequential, coherent manner
questions.solution: Logical flow presents ideas in a coherent, sequential manner.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Gas Testing must be done by
questions.solution: Person with valid certificate.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Safety Consultation with Workers' in mines requires
options: Consultation only after a serious accident
Consultation only with the trade-union office bearers
Regular, meaningful consultation on safety matters
Consultation only during the preparation of the annual return
questions.solution: Worker consultation must be regular and meaningful.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Emergency communication includes
questions.solution: Radio, whistle, alarm, siren.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Swing Radius' of excavators in opencast mines must be
options: Clear of personnel and other equipment
questions.solution: Excavator swing radius must be clear of personnel and other equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Mines Rules 1955 are framed under
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'end use planning' for reclaimed land should consider
options: Long-term sustainability, community needs, and environmental suitability
The present market price of the land
The season in which the reclamation is carried out
questions.solution: End use planning must balance long-term sustainability, community needs, and environmental factors.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Pit dewatering in opencast mines involves
options: Removing groundwater to maintain dry working conditions
questions.solution: Dewatering removes groundwater to ensure safe and dry working conditions in the pit.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'safety risk register' should be reviewed
options: Regularly and whenever new hazards are identified
Only by the DGMS inspecting officer
questions.solution: Risk registers must be reviewed regularly and updated with new hazard information.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'End dumping' deposits material from
options: The edge of the bench or dump surface
questions.solution: From the edge of the bench.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Workplace' in an underground mine as per CMR 2017 includes
options: The mine canteen and its premises
The pit top arrangements near the shaft
Any place in a mine to which any person has lawful access
questions.solution: As per CMR 2017, a 'working place' means any place in a mine to which any person has lawful access.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Mine capacity planning considers
options: Equipment availability, geological conditions, and market projections
questions.solution: Capacity planning must consider equipment, geology, and market factors for sustainable production.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rules 1955, 'Rock Dusting' application rate depends on
options: Coal dust content and explosion risk assessment
questions.solution: Rock dusting rates depend on coal dust levels and explosion risk.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Erosion control blanket protects
options: Mining machinery parked on the bench
Workers resting at the pit bottom
questions.solution: Newly seeded slopes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum number of shots a shot-firer may charge and fire in a shift in a gassy seam (first degree) belowground is:
options: 40 (single-shot exploder) / 80 (multi-shot) — applicable to Degree II & III
50 (single-shot exploder) / 100 (multi-shot) — applicable to other seams including Degree I
No limit if multi-shot exploder is used
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg. 190: Degree II/III seams 40/80 shots per shift; other seams (including first degree) 50/100; opencast 60/120.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Notice of Accident' under the Mines Act must be given within
questions.solution: Serious accidents must be reported within 24 hours to the Inspector of Mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'shootfirer' in coal mines must hold a valid
options: Shotfirer certificate and required competency qualifications
questions.solution: Shotfirers must hold valid certificates as required under CMR 2017 and Mines Act 1952.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Flyrock in blasting can be controlled by
options: Proper stemming, burden, and spacing design
questions.solution: Proper blast design with adequate stemming, burden, and spacing minimizes flyrock risk.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety policy of a mine should be displayed at
options: Prominently at the mine site and accessible to all workers
questions.solution: The safety policy must be prominently displayed and accessible to all mine personnel.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Working Place' in Mines Rules 1955 includes
options: Any place in the mine where a worker is required to work
The mine canteen premises and the store rooms
The rest room facilities provided for the workers
questions.solution: Working place includes any location where workers are required to work.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Primers in shot firing are
options: Small charges used to initiate the main charge
The largest charges in the blast
questions.solution: Primers are small explosive charges used to reliably initiate the main explosive column.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Sub-grade' excavation in opencast mining is done for
questions.solution: Done for drainage below seam floor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rules 1955, the 'Depth Indicator' in shafts must be
options: Maintained and accurate for indicating cage position
questions.solution: Depth indicators must be maintained and accurate for indicating cage position in shafts.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Equipment Breakdown Report includes
options: Equipment ID, nature of breakdown, root cause, downtime and repair action
questions.solution: ID, nature, cause, repair.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The Velocity of Detonation (VOD) of an explosive is
options: The speed of the sound wave in air
The speed at which the shock wave travels through the rock
The average speed of the loaded dumpers
The speed at which the detonation wave travels through the explosive
questions.solution: VOD is the velocity at which the detonation wave propagates through the explosive column.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Before loading by shovel, a dumper should be:
options: Correctly positioned at loading point and operator following loading protocol
questions.solution: Truck positioned and engine off.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Burden in blasting is

questions.stem: Which vegetation type is most suitable for reclaimed mine dumps?

Plants that grow in standing water

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
